format: 16-bit greyscale PNG, 2048 x 2048 (also raw little-endian Uint16: mychief-map-height-2048.u16, mychief-map-height-1024.u16)
extent_note: Samples are VERTICES. Sample (row i, col j) sits at x = -4094 + 4*j, z = -4094 + 4*i. Vertex-to-vertex size is 8188 m (~8.2 x 8.2 km). The 1024 raw file keeps every 2nd sample (8 m spacing, same 8188 m extent, x = -4094 + 8*j).

origin.meaning: Tower centre. Tower base ground y = 0 (exact, flat pad r~10 m). Tower sits between the 4 centre samples (rows/cols 1023-1024).

axes_threejs.bearing: bearing 0 = north (-z), 90 = east (+x); x = sin(b)*d, z = -cos(b)*d (same as GD geo.js polar())

nominal_elevation_note: Flavour only (for UI/altimeter text); nothing in the files depends on it.
albedo_alignment: mychief-map-albedo-*.jpg, splat and masks cover exactly the same square (UV 0..1 = x/z -4094..+4094, image top = north). Use PlaneGeometry default UVs.
